description: This file defines the UploadedFileInterface interface within the PSR-7 HTTP message standard, specifying methods for handling uploaded files in web requests, including retrieving streams, moving files, and getting metadata.

classes.name: UploadedFileInterface
classes.description: An interface representing an uploaded file, providing methods for accessing file streams, moving files, and retrieving upload metadata.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Returns a StreamInterface instance representing the uploaded file; throws exception if no stream is available.

methods.name: moveTo
methods.description: Moves the uploaded file to a specified path; raises exception if called multiple times.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the file size in bytes or null if unknown.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Returns the upload error status, corresponding to PHP's UPLOAD_ERR_XXX constants.

methods.name: getClientFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename sent by the client or null.

methods.name: getClientMediaType
methods.description: Returns the media type sent by the client or null.
